entry.title: Issue in DCGR Generation for Condition Type MM00
entry.content:
Issue: Delivery Cost (DCGR) is not getting generated against condition type MM00 (configured as Condition Category B - Delivery Costs) for PO 4200022817.

Analysis Performed:

  • MM00 condition is successfully fetched in the PO pricing conditions 
  • Configuration in M/06 confirms MM00 is maintained as a delivery cost condition (Condition Category B).
  • MM00 is assigned in pricing procedure ZM0009 through transaction M/08.
  • After Goods Receipt, delivery cost document is not generated against MM00, whereas delivery costs are generated successfully for condition type ZTV1 in the same PO.
  • Request to SAP: Kindly review the standard system behavior and advise why DCGR is not generated for condition type MM00, despite the condition being configured as Delivery Cost (Category B) and maintained in the pricing procedure, while other delivery cost conditions (e.g., ZTV1) are generating delivery cost documents successfully.
